about: Every direct dependency apps/mobile may declare (mobile foundation contract §8 and its CI guard). Names only: versions come from the Expo SDK's compatibility check and the lockfile. Adding a package, and above all any @captain/* package, needs a reviewed amendment. The guard refuses @captain/* here regardless.

dependencies.expo-router: file routes, per-tab stacks, links, back navigation (§8)
dependencies.expo-linking: expo-router peer listed by the SDK router installation docs (§8)
dependencies.expo-constants: expo-router peer listed by the SDK router installation docs (§8)
dependencies.react-native-screens: expo-router peer listed by the SDK router installation docs (§8)
dependencies.react-native-safe-area-context: expo-router peer listed by the SDK router installation docs (§8)
dependencies.expo-status-bar: status bar component installed with the SDK router setup
dependencies.@expo/metro-runtime: Metro runtime the SDK router setup installs for web export
dependencies.@expo/log-box: expo-router peer the SDK resolves; allowed only if the root install requires it
dependencies.react-dom: SDK-matched peer of react-native-web for the web bundle export
dependencies.react-native-web: SDK-matched web renderer for the web bundle export
dependencies.expo-secure-store: session and organisation choice: the only storage mechanism (§8)
dependencies.expo-crypto: random bytes and SHA-256 for PKCE and attempts (§8, Q10)

devDependencies.@types/react-dom: SDK-matched React DOM types for the web export, kept separate from the web app's React types
devDependencies.@types/node: types for node:test pure-logic tests, which run in Node, never in the app bundle
devDependencies.tsx: runs the TypeScript pure-logic tests with node --test (§8)
